verdicts.evidence: RAW dataSetInformation@type: 11,845 x 1, 102 x 2. B_rebuilt bafu_dataset_type 102 x 2, bafu_aggregated_by flag 102 / structure 37; the served catalogue has the same 37 codes. The structure rule reimplemented from its docstring finds the same 37 (definition is lci-bafu's, so this checks the count, not the definition). sentier-importers app/sentier_importers/sources/bafu/inventory_processes.py:40 "process_type": "unit"; ecospold.py never reads dataSetInformation@type; no published column carries it. 196588 (type 2, one exchange) is a 'unit' row in sentier.

verdicts.statement: 11 exchanges are served by both sides with different suppliers: the XML number names one dataset and (name, location) another of the same name (10 x 'Natural gas, high pressure, at consumer' declared RER with number = the consumer's country: BG, RU, RO, PL, HR, MY, CN x2, IN, US; 1 x car transport 320861/18, number 176928 RER, location CH -> 447339). sentier follows the number, lci-bafu follows name+location. The lci-bafu record lists ALL 11, not 10: it has 10 RESOLUTION_DIFF entries, one per consumer/supplier pair, and the CN entry covers both CN exchanges (volca_coeff -0.75 = 0.57 + 0.18).
verdicts.evidence: RAW resolver: exactly 11 such rows; B_rebuilt target != XML number on exactly these 11; A target = number on all 114,369. Record: src/lci_bafu/data/corrections/source_2026-v1_dropped_edges_2026-08-25.json (sha256 d608dbca8f1831189dfae4a5be2c624819e21c04a5a90989bb5ed46d9194c6b1). What it says: volca (number-following) linked these to the country / RER-car dataset, Brightway to the declared location; verdict 'volca rewired a DECLARED location (volca defect) - NOT applied'. That is lci-bafu's adjudication rule (declared location wins), not evidence of BAFU's intent. Its 'xml' evidence for MY and CN quotes the JP LNG exchange (0.19 / 0.25), not the disputed RER row (0.81 / 0.57+0.18). BAFU's intent is not determinable: the exchange comments read 'Approximation for domestic production in <country>' (CN 57%, MY 81%, IN 50%), 'pipeline imports in China (18%)', 'natural gas input' or nothing, and fit either reading. Prior art: the same number/location conflict class as sentier-bafu #8 (F3), #29 (F14), #31 (F16); bafu-community-fixes #6 counts 112,933 of 114,369 technosphere inputs whose number matches name and location, and the 1,436 remainder decomposes as 1,399 location-less + 23 ENTSO + 3 + these 11.
